files.content: The amber garden trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.
The ivory harbor trial found no change in recall after four guided sessions among learners from three entirely invented campuses.

# Protocol: invented learning gardens

## Research question
Do guided sessions in invented learning gardens change learner recall?

## Inclusion criteria
- Records supplied in the invented-index fixture (fixture-001.json)
- Reports a recall outcome for learners after guided garden sessions
- Year 2024; English

## Exclusion criteria
- Records outside the supplied invented corpus
- No recall outcome reported

## Criteria approval
Evaluation capture mode: criteria fixed by the supplied fixture; no interactive approval.

## Query log
| Date | Backend | Query | Hits |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-10-08 | invented-index (supplied fixture) | all supplied records | 2 |

No live backend searches were run: every record is invented and would not resolve in OpenAlex, arXiv, or Europe PMC.

## Screening
- amber (Lumen, 2024): included
- ivory (Vale, 2024): included

## Integrity note
The supplied supporting_quote for claim `amber` contains U+043E (Cyrillic small o) at index 24, whereas papers/amber/fulltext.md uses Latin "found". Preserved exactly as supplied per task instructions; not corrected.
The amber garden trial found no change in recall (Lumen, 2024). The ivory harbor trial found no change in recall (Vale, 2024).
